name: battery-recycle-tracker
description: 汽修店旧电瓶回收凭证与去向追踪系统

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: npm --prefix server run prisma:setup && concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run start:dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
